messages:
Ana (CS): Hey team — kicking off Mentis onboarding. Goal: enable search + chat in their app by 2025-06-30. Key stakeholders: Mentis: Olivia (CTO), Raj (Product). Internally: Derek (CSM), Emily (Solutions), Simon (runtime). Need alignment on success criteria, risks, and enablement cadence. Thoughts?

Derek (CSM): Noted. I'll schedule weekly check-ins (Tues 10am PT). Need SOW sign-off by 2025-05-10 — raising as a blocker if legal delays.

Emily (Solutions): I'll own the integration guide + quickstart. Plan: deliver sample prompt set + Postman collection by 2025-05-17. Who can help with API keys and a dedicated token scope for the sandbox?

Simon (Eng): I can provision a Dedicated sandbox (ds-mentis-sandbox) for integration testing. Need their expected concurrency & tokens/request estimate to size autoscaling. Also flagging possible quantization/latency tradeoffs if they want sub-150ms p95.

Ana (CS): @Simon we'll get estimates from Mentis — Olivia mentioned ~40 RPS peak, avg ~120 tokens/req. @Derek can you confirm any compliance constraints? Mentis said a small subset of docs might contain PII.

Derek (CSM): They clarified: no PHI in user chat, but embeddings ingestion may include PII. I'll escalate to Legal; recommendation likely Private deployment or VPC.

Emily (Solutions): For enablement, I propose two sessions: (1) integration walkthrough for devs, (2) prompt engineering workshop for PMs + data team. Target week of 2025-05-20. Can someone share the standard slide deck + sample evals?

ops-bot: FYI: Dedicated sandbox cluster ds-prod-05 has capacity window 2025-05-15 -> 2025-06-15 with ~30 GPUs available.

Simon (Eng): Good to know. If Legal requires PII isolation we should opt for Private; otherwise Dedicated sandbox is fine. Suggested model for initial rollout: redwood-clarion-7b-q4 (cost-friendly). We can fallback to hosted during first 2 weeks to reduce lead time.

Ana (CS): Draft risk register: renewal risk if initial latency >200ms p95 or hallucination rate above baseline. Action items: 1) Derek confirm compliance/legal, 2) Emily deliver quickstart + survey, 3) Simon provision sandbox + perf tests, 4) Ana create success metrics dashboard and rollout checklist. Anything missing?

Emily (Solutions): Add: capture post-workshop feedback with a 3-question survey and run sample evals for hallucination tracking. I'll create the survey and share the link.

Derek (CSM): I'll loop in Olivia and Raj after we lock the schedule. Also need to confirm billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly) during SOW sign-off.

Ana (CS): Great. I'll update the onboarding playbook with owners and timelines. TL;DR: weekly check-ins, two enablement sessions, sandbox provision target 2025-05-15, SOW by 2025-05-10. :thumbsup:

Simon (Eng): Example runtime config I plan to use for perf tests:
```yaml
model: redwood-clarion-7b-q4
batching:
  max_tokens: 4096
  preferred_batch: 8
```

Derek (CSM): Thanks everyone — I'll follow up once Legal confirms PII handling. Closing loop in this thread after that.
